data.name: Faizi
data.gender_notes: Faizi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-a-z', meaning 'to open' or 'to be victorious'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes success, triumph, and the opening of doors to opportunities. The name Faizi carries the meaning “Victorious, Successful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faizi usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, successful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the spirit of victory and success in your personal journey.
data.etymology: Faizi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Successful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faizi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: فائزي

The name Faizi is also associated with the qualities of generosity, kindness, and compassion. In modern times, the name Faizi is still used to signify good fortune, prosperity, and generosity.
